# Screen System

> UI manager for Unity 6 (uGUI and UI Toolkit). Screens are composed from reusable layer prefabs listed in a `LayerDefinition`; screens share layer instances and the system sets every layer's draw order. Navigate by screen name with `ScreenManager.Instance.GoTo`, `GoBack`, `PopTo` and `SetRoot`, switch tabs with `GoTo(screen, NavigationHistory.ClearToRoot)`, and pass a typed value with `GoTo(screen, value)` to components implementing `IScreenParameter<T>`, await a modal's answer with `GoToForResult<T>` and `CloseWithResult(value)`; screens are prefabs with a `ScreenDefinition`, loaded from Resources or Addressables. All UI lives in one DontDestroyOnLoad object; a single scene load unloads every screen except Persist Over Scenes ones, the splash and the quit confirmation, and releases their Addressables handles. At most one fullscreen, one modal and one alert render at once. Back stack, Escape-key back navigation, lifecycle interfaces (`IScreenShow`, `IScreenHide`), navigation events, profiler markers, a benchmark sample and optional dependency injection. Tested on Android with IL2CPP. Requires Tools Core, Addressables and the Input System. MIT licensed, pre-release (0.x), single author, no other users yet.
